title: Leapting launches autonomous forklift for solar module transport
summary: The Chinese robotics manufacturer has introduced an autonomous tracked forklift capable of transporting solar module pallets weighing up to 3,000 kg. The battery-powered machine features a maximum lifting height of 3 m, a 30-degree climbing capability and a navigation system combining GNSS-RTK, laser SLAM and computer vision. The post Leapting launches autonomous forklift for solar module transport appeared first on pv magazine Global .
